message.content:
Here’s a quick mix of horror films spanning classic, modern, supernatural, slasher, psychological, and indie styles—so you’ll have something for almost every mood:

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑genre / Notable Twist |
|---|-------|------|---------------------------|
| 1 | **Psycho** | 1960 | Classic psychological thriller – iconic shower scene |
| 2 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Gothic haunted hotel, Jack Nicholson’s descent |
| 3 | **Halloween** | 1978 | Found‑footage slasher, Michael Myers’ first appearance |
| 4 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | Demonic possession, chilling realism |
| 5 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Family curse, intense dread |
| 6 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social satire meets horror, twist ending |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Silence‑based suspense, family survival |
| 8 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Daylight horror, cult rituals |
| 9 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Viral curse, relentless stalker |
|10 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological monster, grief metaphor |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Japanese remake, cursed videotape |
|12 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | Paranormal investigators, real‑life inspiration |
|13 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found‑footage home invasion |
|14 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑horror, twist on tropes |
|15 | **The Others** | 2001 | Haunted house, twist reveal |
|16 | **It** | 2017 | Stephen King adaptation, clown terror |
|17 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Puritan horror, atmospheric dread |
|18 | **The Descent** | 2005 | Cave‑exploration, claustrophobic monsters |
|19 | **The Texas Chainsaw Massacre** | 1974 | Realistic gore, Leatherface |
|20 | **The Blair Witch Project** | 1999 | Found‑footage, psychological terror |

Feel free to pick based on your preferred style—whether you’re after a slow‑burn psychological scare or a fast‑paced slasher. Enjoy the chills!
